about_the_game:
A set of Mana Seeds, potions, and mascots. Potions will remain empty after use, increasing the number of recovery potions you can carry. Mascots can be displayed anywhere onscreen.

Healing Potion
Mark of the Sword
Mini Karja

*Healing Potion and Mark of the Sword can also be obtained in-game.
*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, place mascots via [Items] -> [Used Items] in the main menu.
*Please note that all items in excess of the maximum amount will be lost.
